name: Ragi Onion Dosa
steps: Whisk ragi flour, rice flour, soy yogurt, cumin, salt and water into a thin, lump-free batter.
Rest 10 minutes. Stir in onion and coriander; add water if needed for a pourable consistency.
Heat a seasoned non-stick dosa pan over medium-high and wipe with a little oil.
Pour a ladle of batter from the outside inward; do not spread like a thick pancake. Drizzle a few drops of oil around the edge.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the edges lift and the base is crisp. Fold and serve; repeat.
note: Ragi dosa is naturally gluten-free when all packaged ingredients are certified gluten-free. The batter is thinner than regular dosa batter.
